high_level_description: This image captures a serene beach scene at what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the soft, warm light illuminating the sky. The sky is a mix of pastel hues, with shades of pink, orange, and blue blending together, creating a tranquil and peaceful atmosphere. There are scattered clouds in the sky, some of which are tinged with the same warm colors as the horizon. The ocean is in the foreground, with waves gently crashing onto the sandy shore. The waves are not very large but have a frothy white crest where they meet the sand.
